newsitem.title: UK: BOC Group sinks on profit-taking.
newsitem.headline: BOC Group sinks on profit-taking.

text.p: Shares in British chemicals group BOC sank on profit-taking on Thursday after having climbed to a four-month high on Wednesday, dealers said.
By 1232 GMT, the shares were down 12-1/2p to 887-1/2p.
Volume was heavy, with almost five million shares trading hands.
The shares rose over the 900p mark on Wednesday after three influential brokers made positive comments about the stock after attending a dinner hosted by BOC senior executives.
"There's something psychological about the nine pound level," said Kleinwort Benson analyst Michael Eastwood, who was among those analysts who repeated his "buy" recommendation.
"People are just taking profits. It's a trading play."
